String.Name: Text
String.Val: Why do you want to create a network communication system?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: To share values You want to share the current temperature, current position, and so on.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: To transmit data You want to transmit a signal, command, and so on.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Which type of values do you want to share?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Basic values You want to share numeric, string, Boolean values, and so on.

String.Name: Sample
String.Val: Shared Variable

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Complex values You want to share a picture, waveform, video, and so on.

String.Name: Sample
String.Val: UDP Data Stream

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Do you want to broadcast your data to one or more myRIOs?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Yes In this case, all myRIOs use the same data communication method. You do not have to specify the IP address of each myRIO.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: No In this case, different myRIOs use different data communication methods. You have to specify the IP address of each myRIO.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: When disconnection occurs, do you want to continue your data communication?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Yes In this situation, the receiver ignores data loss. You can customize your network communication system to acknowledge data.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: No In this situation, the network communication terminates to ensure that no data is lost.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: How many endpoints do you want to have in your network communication system? Endpoints refer to both senders and receivers in a network communication.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: 2 You want to have one sender and one receiver.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: More than 2 You want to have multiple senders or receivers.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Do you want to classify your messages?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Yes You want to divide your messages into different categories and process them separately by using different methods.

String.Name: Sample
String.Val: Simple TCP Messaging

String.Name: Text
String.Val: No You want to process all messages by using the same method.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Do you want the receiver to process the message as soon as it arrives?

String.Name: Text
String.Val: Yes The receiver has to process the message before it receives the next message.

String.Name: Text
String.Val: No The receiver can put all messages in a queue and process them when necessary.

String.Name: Sample
String.Val: Queued Message
